metadataRaw.title: How to Quickly Relieve Knee Stiffness after Sitting
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve knee stiffness after sitting too long.

If you're dealing with the feeling of a 'locked-up' stiff knee that causes pain from sitting, or trying to stand up, give these exercises a try.

They're going to focus on helping to improve knee range-of-motion through easy movements that will help loosen up tight muscles and joint stiffness. 

The great part is, you can do them seated (or standing next to a chair).

Let us know which knee exercise works best for you!

Chapters: 
0:00 Seated Exercise
3:29 Calf & Tibialis Raises
4:32 Knee Circles
5:50 Knee Clocks
7:56 Strengthening Exercise
